Guidance & outlook: Starting with R.K.S., our Telangana Maruti division contributed approximately INR126 crores of revenue during Q1 FY27.

Popular Vehicles and Services Limited August 12, 2026 In Q1 FY27, the revenue contribution from Kerala m, or Keralam as is now called, declined to below 50% for the first time, and our focus will be to sustain this more diversified geographic revenue mix going forward.
There was a reported profit of INR1.4 crores in quarter 1 of FY27 versus a loss of INR8.8 crores in quarter 1 of FY26.
Growth & demand: Total vehicle volumes increased approximately 81%, while overall reported service volumes grew marginally by approximately 1%, but on a like -to-like basis, after excluding Honda and Piaggio from the previous year base, the revenue growth was approximately 52%, new vehicle volumes grew approximately 91% and service volumes grew 13%.
New vehicle volumes increased by 39%, and service volumes grew approximately 87%.
New vehicle volumes grew 153%, while service volumes grew 60%.
Margins & costs: Coming to profitability, reported EBITDA increased approximately 87% Y -o-Y to INR71.5 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 3.8% from 2.9% in Q1 last year.
EBITDA margin stood at 3.8% for quarter 1 of FY27.
In terms of overall EBITDA margin hitting the 5% will take a long time because our commercial vehicle contribution has increased significantly, where the EBITDA margins are a bit lower.
Capex & expansion: For a comparison, this business contributed approximately INR151 crores during the full half year of FY26 following the acquisition.
And the Audi operations acquired from Olympus Motors contributed approximately INR20 crores from Q1 compared to INR20 crores from the Q4 of last year.
What is particularly important is th at despite the significant increase in revenue and expansion of our network, absolute inventory increased by only about 14% year -on-year.
Balance sheet & cash: Our focus from here on is improving utilization, increasing service throughput and extracting further operating leverage.

This allows us to leverage our existing warehouses, distribution infrastructure and customer relationships and also support the Popular Vehicles and Services Limited August 12, 2026 broader objective of increasing the contribution from recurring and higher -margin aftermarket revenues.
New vehicle inventory days stood approximately at 32 days compared with around 50 days a year ago and remain broadly around the industry levels.
Risks & challenges: Organic service volumes, however, declined by a small margin.
Nexa continued to perform well, while Arena has also returned to growth after being under pressure over the last couple of years.
The acquired dealerships had a relatively subdued service throughput when we took over these businesses.
